description: This file implements the GatekeeperWindowsChannel class, which manages communication over Windows named pipes for the Gatekeeper service, including connection handling, message sending, and receiving.

classes.name: GatekeeperWindowsChannel
classes.description: A class that manages Windows named pipe communication for the Gatekeeper service, including connection setup, message transmission, and reception.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create and initialize a GatekeeperWindowsChannel instance with a given pipe handle.

methods.name: WaitForConnection
methods.description: Waits for a client to connect to the specified named pipe handle.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message over the pipe.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message over the pipe.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Internal method to send a message, handling serialization and overlapped I/O.

methods.name: ReadFromPipe
methods.description: Reads data from the pipe asynchronously.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives and deserializes a message from the pipe.
